blocks.text: For businesses considering a physical location in Cebu’s South Road Properties, another commercial space is taking shape within an established residential development at City di Mare. Sanremo Oasis is offering 11 commercial units in Building 8, with floor areas ranging from 75.32 to 114.58 square meters. Each unit comes with a balcony, while the development’s design incorporates a commercial area alongside other added features. The spaces are being developed as part of Sanremo Oasis at City di Mare, giving prospective business owners and investors an option to establish a commercial presence within a residential community rather than starting with a standalone commercial property.
